work: Room drafts — bridge, storm wedge. Wet lab, pipe knot. Dry lab, long data wall. Mess hall, galley booth. Medical bay, upright light over a berth. Crew quarters, repeating cabin passage. Editing room, dark monitor nook. Engineering workshop, bright overhead view of a tool island. Portrait drafts — Thomas, seated pitch. Sarah, standing watch. Maya, patient forward arc. Daniel, square bend. Olivia, sideways listening pose. Lucas, backward lean with a camera. First comparison — the wet lab and workshop both read as bright industrial clutter, so the workshop gained a dark perimeter and an ordered tool island. The medical bay and crew quarters shared a straight view and repeated uprights, so the passage gained a staggered layout seen from a doorway. The dry lab and editing room shared a cold screen glow, so the editing room gained a pool of amber light and a diagonal desk. Thomas and Maya both leaned into an explanation, so Thomas moved into a tight seated crop with a counting gesture. Daniel and Lucas both held equipment at hip height, so Lucas gained a two-handed framing gesture. Second comparison — the dry lab and editing room still share a dark corner view, but their long horizontal band and diagonal wedge read differently at thumbnail size. Sarah and Daniel still share a hip-up crop and hard light, so Sarah keeps a straight outline with both arms down while Daniel breaks his outline with a bent elbow and lifted hand. Thomas and Maya still meet the viewer's gaze while gesturing, with compact fingers against the chest for Thomas and a broad forward arc for Maya. The sources leave appearance open, so the portrait designs supply it.

rooms.description: From standing height above the chart station, a slanted storm pane fills the left half with white water. Radar and weather screens step down the right wall. A thumb-polished radio clip catches the backlight.
rooms.feeling: The polished radio clip suggests a watch kept by touch, and the white water makes the orderly bridge feel exposed.

rooms.description: From the threshold, clear water lines braid beneath steel benches over black anti-slip flooring. A fixed bench strip catches condensation and orange pump guards. Sample bottles clip into a rack with one thumb-worn latch.
rooms.feeling: The thumb-worn latch hints at a practiced routine inside a room that feels wet, loud and tangled.

rooms.description: From a shallow corner, a single wall-wide display draws a thin tide trace above a graphite worktop. Blue scientific note tabs sit under a clear retaining strip. Screen glow fades into acoustic wall felt.
rooms.feeling: The blue tabs mark where someone keeps returning to the same data, and the moving tide trace feels almost soundless.

rooms.description: At banquette height, a rectangular bolted table interlocks with squared seat backs and honey-yellow galley cupboards. Ceiling light softens the refrigerator latch, wall-clipped coffee pot and a row of mismatched mugs clipped beneath the galley shelf.
rooms.feeling: The mismatched mugs make the mess feel domestic, even with the coffee pot clipped to a bulkhead.

rooms.description: A tall examination lamp bends over a narrow fixed berth, pooling ivory light on its clean pillow. Beyond it, a latched cabinet and compact diagnostic station flank a report desk with a pen clipped exactly parallel.
rooms.feeling: The squared-up pen makes the room feel exacting, while the lit pillow makes that same attention feel tender.

rooms.description: Seen through a dogged hatch, eight cabin doors in staggered recesses make a sawtooth shadow down the short passage. Recessed ceiling lamps drop small amber pools. One door has a palm-sized photograph under a screwed-down clear cover.
rooms.feeling: The photograph offers a glimpse of home in a passage where every closed door promises privacy.

rooms.description: From the corner, the narrow desk cuts diagonally across the frame. Amber task light picks out a camera strapped to its charging dock and pinned thumbnail sketches. A clamped laptop and side monitor graze violet earcups on a locking hook.
rooms.feeling: The pinned thumbnail sketches make the cramped survey office feel like somewhere a restless eye has learned to sit still.

rooms.description: Look steeply down onto a steel island marked by a red vise and a precise grid of sockets clipped into shallow drawers. A ceiling batten strikes jaw marks in the vise. The bolted test rig falls into shadow.
rooms.feeling: The scarred vise bears the force of daily work, while the sockets sit in the most exact rows aboard.

people.description: Broad through the chest with a round face and dark hair combed flat, he settles into a crisp navy shirt. Warm reflected light catches his smile as his thumb counts consequences against two fingers held close to his collar.
people.feeling: He counts practical consequences on his fingers with a smile that makes the tally feel like an invitation.

people.description: Lean and straight through the torso, she wears a charcoal ship uniform with sleeves buttoned at the wrist. Hard side light cuts across her long face and rope braid. Arms down, she turns one ear toward the speaker.
people.feeling: She turns an ear to hear the speaker out, a small courtesy in a stance that could bring the whole bridge to attention.

people.description: Compact and narrow through the ribs, she curves forward in an ochre cardigan over a striped shirt. Soft light catches a blunt fringe and one dimple. She draws a broad arc with her index finger, meeting the listener’s eyes.
people.feeling: She traces the arc slowly enough for a newcomer to follow, while the deep crease between her brows stays even when she smiles.

people.description: Tall and broad across the shoulders, he hunches in a grease-marked canvas jacket with an orange zipper pull. Hard light catches his clean-shaven jaw and tight braids. He turns a tethered coupling as if opening a jam jar.
people.feeling: He turns the coupling like a jam jar with surprising delicacy for someone who wastes so few words.

people.description: Narrow shoulders and wide hips turn sideways in a fitted knit with a violet cuff. A pool of light picks out her freckled nose and smooth low bun. Her crossed forearms loosen when the speaker pauses.
people.feeling: She loosens her arms when someone pauses, making an initially guarded pose feel like room to keep talking.

people.description: Short and wiry, he leans back in a loose green overshirt with neatly mended cuffs. Backlight catches his straight black hair and crooked nose. One elbow juts as both hands square a frame around something above him.
people.feeling: His hands snap into a precise frame even as the rest of him looks ready to move on.
